rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when putting people or things into groups.

example.english: We usually group the contestants into teams of four.
example.traditional: 我哋通常將參賽者分組，每組四個人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 zoeng1 caam1 coi3 ze2 fan1 zou2 mui5 zou2 sei3 go3 jan4

rows.note: This is the everyday choice for a group or bunch of people, especially an informal or casually identified group.

example.english: Our group is going for drinks after work.
example.traditional: 我哋一班人放工後去飲嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 baan1 jan4 fong3 gung1 hau6 heoi3 jam2 je5

rows.note: Use this for a defined or organized group of people or things, such as a work group or a set of objects.

example.english: This group of colleagues is responsible for organizing the documents.
example.traditional: 呢組同事負責整理文件。
example.jyutping: ni1 zou2 tung4 si6 fu6 zaak3 zing2 lei5 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for a loose, often untidy bunch or pile of things rather than an organized group.

example.english: There is a group of things on the table.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi4 soeng6 min6 jau5 jat1 deoi1 je5

rows.note: Use this when people come together to form a group.

example.english: After work, we come together as a group for dinner.
example.traditional: 放工後，我哋成班人聚埋一齊食飯。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 jan4 zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a band or other small ensemble that performs music together.

example.english: This music group is performing at a bar tonight.
example.traditional: 呢隊樂隊今晚喺酒吧表演。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 ngok6 deoi6 gam1 maan5 hai2 zau2 baa1 biu2 jin2
